optical_live_smoke.observed_failure: luma-optical.service failed in the initrd; systemd-veritysetup@root and veritysetup.target failed on that dependency; dracut-initqueue timed out waiting for /dev/mapper/root and the guest halted at 325.286 s without a shell; the harness then timed out after 1800 s waiting for the root prompt
optical_live_smoke.root_cause: luma-optical.sh ran 'set -eu' and then sourced /lib/dracut-lib.sh, which references the unset NEWROOT outside dracut's own hooks and aborts the script; reproduced offline as '/lib/dracut-lib.sh: NEWROOT: parameter not set'
optical_live_smoke.source_fix: native/image/overlay/usr/lib/dracut/modules.d/91luma/luma-optical.sh reads /proc/cmdline directly, requires each key exactly once and forces the single CD read-only before requiring ro=1; regression tests in native/tests/test_optical_media.py
optical_live_smoke.subsequent_diagnostic: optical_discovery_diagnostic found a second optical defect, now fixed in source

optical_discovery_diagnostic.purpose: Software-only diagnostic of the source-fixed discovery script; direct kernel boot bypasses the signed UKI, so it is not image, Secure Boot or release evidence
attached_block_devices: read-only AHCI CD carrying the ISO
optical_discovery_diagnostic.finding_first_defect: The fixed script discovered the single read-only CD, created both read-only loops and the initrd opened the verity root; the dracut-library abort is resolved
optical_discovery_diagnostic.finding_second_defect: After switch-root the real root regenerated systemd-veritysetup@root, which waited 90 s for /dev/luma-optical-root and /dev/luma-optical-hash and failed because the naming udev rule existed only in the initrd; the already-open root kept running
optical_discovery_diagnostic.second_defect_source_fix: native/image/overlay/etc/udev/rules.d/99-luma-optical.rules ships in the root and module-setup.sh copies that one file into the initrd with inst_multiple; boot_policy.verify_initrd compares it with the overlay; regression test test_real_root_names_optical_loops_after_switch_root
optical_discovery_diagnostic.signed_media_verify_memory_finding: luma-platform verify /media/luma exited 1 in the 4096-MiB guest because RAM-backed staging was unavailable; the signed optical smoke runs it with 6 GiB
optical_discovery_diagnostic.harness_defect: The failed-units observation ran systemctl without --no-pager, so the serial console entered a pager (it listed two failed units) and the harness stopped waiting for the observation marker (1800-s wait capped by the 3600-s run deadline) before power-off, so clean_shutdown is null; the executed harness is retained unchanged and a re-run needs a new versioned file

observed_in: sequence-17 optical discovery diagnostic serial log
known_issues.mechanism: A path unit with default dependencies is Before=paths.target, basic.target is After=paths.target and the keeper service is After=basic.target, so luma-utc-producer.path or luma-utc-recovery-producer.path After=its keeper closed a cycle; systemd deleted a different job per boot (paths.target, luma-utc-producer.path or luma-utc-recovery-producer.path)
known_issues.impact: When a producer path is dropped, authenticated network time does not start in that boot
known_issues.source_fix: Both producer .path units use DefaultDependencies=no with explicit sysinit/shutdown edges; regression test test_producer_paths_do_not_close_a_boot_ordering_cycle

known_issues.issue: luma-utc-recovery-keeper.service failed in the optical diagnostic boot
known_issues.note: It started in the disk smoke; the next signed optical smoke must capture its journal
